quantity: monthly mean 500 hPa eastward and northward wind, m/s
source: NOAA PSL NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 monthly means; reanalysis is not independent observations
representation: real toroidal and poloidal vector spherical harmonics, degrees 1 through 6; exclude singular pole rows
climatology: 12 monthly coefficient means fitted using training dates only
learner: least-squares scalar AR(1) per harmonic coefficient, constrained to [-0.98,0.98], shrinkage selected on validation from [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1]
comparison: full low-degree anomalies vs even-degree toroidal anomalies; both add identical full climatology
ablation_boundary: even-only suppresses odd and divergent anomaly channels, not the entire climatological wind; no claim that even degrees imply slow dynamics
baselines: persisted spectral anomaly plus target-month climatology
score: cos(latitude)-weighted vector RMSE against independent-time low-degree projections and full resolved wind; skill=1-MSE/model_climatology_MSE
test_protocol: target month in test interval; initial state strictly before target; all fitted parameters fixed before test; monthly inputs are retrospectively available reanalysis, not an operational as-of archive
publication: experimental; generation date and input cutoff explicit; no weather skill assertion from delivery tests; no assimilation; numerical Python prototype, not a native Adva learned model
